_about: External free sources (v12): Openverse (CC images, no key) and Pixabay (Pixabay Content License, key injected on the wire). User rules 2026-11-03: free only; no repeated photo/clip; never another place's media as exact; Pixabay / generic stock = representative only; Openverse licences by, by-sa, cc0, pdm only (no NC/ND).

openverse._about_seed: assets/<out>/_seed/openverse_<query>.json = API responses fetched outside the sandbox (Hark web fetcher) when api.openverse.org answers 429 to the sandbox IP; used only when the live call fails, and the run records http=[<code>, 'seed_webfetch'].

pixabay._about_key: connect_service 'pixabay' (host pixabay.com): the proxy swaps __SAVED_KEY__ in the connected URL for the real key. The key is never in code, logs or caches (cache keys/URLs store the placeholder). Images endpoint: proxy answered 400 'keep the connected URL as given up to and including __SAVED_KEY__' on 2 tries (2026-11-03) = connected URL covers /api/videos/ only.
pixabay._about_eye_ok: Download mode only takes candidates listed in eye_ok (agent looked at the thumbnail contact sheet first); nothing un-looked-at is ever downloaded.

themes._about: Generic beat themes for representative stock: keyword (Hindi/Hinglish, in the beat text) -> theme. First match wins per keyword order; a beat may get several themes.

assign._about: Representative stock only replaces continued_with_motion beats. Exact same-place Openverse photos (title/tags name the shot's own place, eye-checked) may replace any continued beat of an exact shot. Stock starts only after the held photo (or its parallax clip) already ran hold_cap_s; from then on every remaining continued beat of that hold gets stock (the photo may not come back = no repeat).

_about_wrong_places: A candidate whose title/tags/description names any of these is rejected (word-boundary match). Gujarat towns outside Dwarka are rejected too: they are real but other places.
_about_landmark_words: Recognisable non-Dwarka landmarks / foreign cues -> reject (generic stock must not show a place).
_about_people_words: Identifiable-person cues in tags/title -> reject for stock (no releases; never imply a real person was there).
